description: **Generated validators no longer call the constraint vocabulary "phase-2", and the generated-code format moves to 2.** The comment on the evidence entry point (`ValidateBytesWithEvidence` in Go, `validate_bytes_with_evidence` in Python, `validateBytesWithEvidence` in TypeScript) now reads "evidence for the constraint vocabulary". Because the emitted code changed, `strictspec check` reports every committed validator as stale after upgrading. The remedy: regenerate each validator with `strictspec gen`, and raise your strictspec dependency floor to this release, since a format-2 validator refuses an older runtime at import or init with the format-mismatch error. Validators generated at format 1 keep working against this runtime.

**`strictspec validate --help` describes its modes by what they check.** `--structural-only` now reads "Run the structural checks only" and `--with-domain-checks` reads "Also run the constraint vocabulary checks", instead of numbering them phase-1 and phase-2.
